summary: Runs one unattended pass (reap, lint, file, rebuild, checkpoint) with no scheduler and no wake channel: reaps only an unanswered request rather than a timeout, files defect contracts rather than escalations, and crosses the same admission boundary as any other actor, holding no private powers.
inbox: Push channels wake; position-stamped reads convince. A wake, an event or a message is a hint to re-read, never a fact about the world.
